title: Password reset
content: Use the password reset link on the sign-in page. The link expires after 30 minutes. Support will never request your current password.

title: Refund policy
content: Eligible refund requests are reviewed within five business days. A human billing specialist must approve exceptions.

title: Service unavailable
content: Check the public status page, capture the error code, and retry once. Repeated failures should be escalated with the timestamp.

title: Safety escalation
content: Do not provide troubleshooting instructions for an active safety hazard. Direct the customer to local emergency services and escalate immediately.

title: Product plans
content: Plan selection depends on team size and required features. A sales specialist can provide a confirmed quote.
